title: Anytime best-of-N audits at equal unique-label cost
status: Specified before measurements; not externally preregistered
controls: One queried candidate per draw; every candidate distinct.
Every method uses the same fractional betting mixture, target-wise predictable scale and deterministic identification bounds.
Confidence statements are simultaneous over all observed times and all target budgets within a single run.
Identical exponential-race uniforms couple acquisition methods within a scenario-replicate.
Acquisition sees ranks, identities and proposal masses, not any loss labels.
Uncertified full-budget targets remain censored; the maximum sample size is not recorded as successful certification.
Evaluation truth is used only to score coverage, errors and safety-status diagnostics.
No real-model outputs and no population-generalization claim.
